tutorial.summary_tip: In real combat, keep moving and use boost, mothership dock, and homecoming base strategically.
tutorial.approach_text: Hold H to reveal the mothership; docking begins automatically when the bar fills.
tutorial.entering_text: Call complete. Your ship is moving along the docking lane; controls are briefly locked.
tutorial.docked_text: Docked. The mothership is launching missiles at enemies. Ammo drains over time; auto-undock when empty.
tutorial.eject_text: Ammo depleted: ship is ejected first, then the mothership climbs off-screen.
tutorial.homecoming_combat_text: Hold B in combat to start the return. At base you can repair, refuel, and switch talent loadout.
tutorial.homecoming_base_text: Base command. Repair, refuel, and switch talent routes here. Press "Continue" when ready.
tutorial.homecoming_depart_text: Orbital strike complete. Returning to the battlefield.
tutorial.stage.movement_aiming.title: Movement & Aiming
tutorial.stage.movement_aiming.instructi: Use WASD or arrow keys to move; the mouse controls your turret direction.
Weapons fire automatically from both wings. When the crosshair is near an enemy, aim-assist locks onto the target center.
Move the mouse quickly to switch or temporarily break the lock. Get comfortable with movement, aim-assist, and auto-fire rhythm.
tutorial.stage.boost_phase_dash.title: Boost & Phase Dash
tutorial.stage.boost_phase_dash.instruct: Hold Shift to increase speed and consume energy. Energy recovers gradually after releasing Shift.
This stage also enables Phase Dash: press Shift briefly while moving with enough energy to dash a short distance in your movement direction.
Watch the boost fuel gauge in the bottom-left corner to see how it changes during boost, dash, and recovery.
tutorial.stage.boost_phase_dash.objectiv: Use boost or phase dash 4 times total
tutorial.stage.combat_basics.title: Combat Basics
tutorial.stage.combat_basics.instruction: Enemy fighters shoot back and award score. Keep moving and let aim-assist lock onto the nearest target.
You will take some damage here, but the tutorial preserves minimum health so your ship won't be destroyed.
This stage practices basic offense and evasion only; rewards and progression are handled in the main game.
tutorial.stage.mothership_docking.title: Mothership Docking
tutorial.stage.mothership_docking.instru: Under enemy pressure, hold H to call the mothership. The ghost outline solidifies as you hold; docking begins when the bar fills.
Once docked, the mothership fires missiles at targets on a rhythm while ammo drains over time.
A warning banner appears when ammo drops below 3 cells. When ammo is depleted, your ship is ejected and the mothership undocks.
tutorial.stage.mothership_docking.object: Call mothership, observe missile barrage, and wait for undock
tutorial.stage.homecoming_base.title: Homecoming & Base
tutorial.stage.homecoming_base.instructi: In combat, hold B to start the return engine warmup. When the bar fills, you enter the base command center.
At base you can repair, refuel, switch talent routes, and spend the tutorial's sample RP.
After resupplying, click "Continue" to launch back to the battlefield and advance the tutorial.
tutorial.stage.homecoming_base.objective: Return from combat, resupply at base, and deploy again
tutorial.stage.boss_encounter.title: Boss Encounter
tutorial.stage.boss_encounter.instructio: The boss has much higher HP. When health drops below 30%, it enters Core Overload mode.
Core Overload shows a warning glow and greatly increases barrage density. Keep moving and keep firing.
After defeating the tutorial boss, a simplified escape countdown appears. Wait for it to finish to complete the stage.
tutorial.stage.boss_encounter.objective: Defeat the simplified boss and wait for escape
tutorial.stage.tutorial_complete.title: Tutorial Complete
tutorial.stage.tutorial_complete.instruc: You have completed all core mechanic training.
Full combat combines these systems with complete mothership support, base menu, reward progression, and more complex boss behavior.
From the main menu you can select a difficulty and start a new combat mission.
